context: A boss reviews HR policy with his deputy
purpose: Teach: 入会/申し出/任命/協同/商法/商工/労使/単行本

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今年の労使協定の見直し案、目を通してくれたか？
lines.en: Have you looked over this year's labor-management agreement revision proposal?
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening a serious policy review meeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、一通り拝読しました。商工会議所の指針にも沿った内容かと思います。
lines.en: Yes, I read through it. I think it aligns with the Chamber of Commerce and Industry guidelines.
lines.style: Polite deputy giving a measured, professional response.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うむ。それから組合への入会手続きについても、新人にきちんと説明するように。
lines.en: Good. Also, make sure to properly explain the union enrollment procedures to the new hires.
lines.style: Firm directive tone, slightly clipped and businesslike.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。実は山田君から、副リーダー職の辞退の申し出がありまして…
lines.en: Understood. Actually, Yamada-kun has submitted a request to decline the deputy leader position...
lines.style: Hesitant deputy raising a delicate personnel matter.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なに？せっかく任命したのに困るな。協同で進めるべき案件が山積みだぞ。
lines.en: What? It's a problem since we just appointed him. We have piles of matters to handle cooperatively.
lines.style: Frustrated boss reacting with mild irritation and authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ごもっともです。商法改正の研修資料も、彼が担当する予定でしたので。
lines.en: Quite right. He was also scheduled to handle the training materials on the Commercial Code revisions.
lines.style: Apologetic agreement, presenting practical consequences calmly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ならば私が書いたあの単行本を参考資料にして、君が引き継いでくれ。
lines.en: Then use that hardcover book I wrote as reference material, and you take over for him.
lines.style: Decisive boss delegating with a hint of self-satisfied pride.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。早速、来週の会議までに準備を整えておきます。
lines.en: Certainly. I'll have everything prepared by next week's meeting right away.
lines.style: Crisp, deferential closing from a reliable subordinate.
